results.title: TIDES
results.overview: After the loss of a loved one, a grieving teenager named Mara battles with her identity, struggling to be her own person without the one she has lost. As buried memories resurface along the beach, her grief progresses from sadness and nostalgia to anger and distress, leading to an eventual emotional collapse and an intense breakdown.

results.title: Senseless Acts of Violence 2
results.overview: Haunted by the aftermath of a camping trip gone wrong, Topher is drawn into a brutal and increasingly surreal world where unseen forces pull the strings—and his understanding of reality begins to fall apart.

results.title: Roterfluss
results.overview: Sir Gareth confronts a life of violence and transgression as he travels the Red River into Hell

results.title: Switches
results.overview: Jake and Dawn, a married couple sliding towards divorce. Two people who once had it all--the career momentum, the chemistry, the “it couple” energy-- are now buried under bills, resentment, and distance. Enter Switch, the trial drug from a hush-hush pharmaceutical company promising an “empathy revolution” by letting couples swap consciousness for 24 hours.

results.title: Insanity
results.overview: 7 friends go on a camping trip after a year of not seeing each other. Everything is going well until a killer wielding a sword and bow comes to join the party...

results.title: The House Party Massacre
results.overview: 8 partying friends are Violently killed by a killer

results.title: Santiago
results.overview: At his grandmother's request, Santiago goes to the cinema in search of the man from whom he inherited his name, a Brazilian actor who passed away in the 1950s but who, on this night, will be brought back to life on the movie screen.

results.title: The Poisonous Cookie 3: The Cursed Cookie
results.original_title: The Poisonous Cookie 3: The Cursed Cookie
results.overview: Max, alongside his sister Luna, must face the dark truth behind a curse that refuses to die.

results.title: Now, I See
results.overview: When a mysterious bicycle accident restores the sight of Simon, a 21-year-old who has been blind his entire life, his miracle comes with an unsettling catch. A cryptic message leads him to a door only he can see, where a secret organization offers him permanent vision at an unimaginable cost: his eyes will become live-streaming cameras, sacrificing his privacy in the name of a "safer world." Forced to choose between the gift of sight and his freedom, Simon must decide what he is truly willing to see.

results.title: Friend, not that way!
results.overview: Franco and Julian, two childhood friends, grew up immersed in the world of reality TV and streaming. However, everything falls apart when they get caught up in a street fight instigated by others, causing them to lose money, damage their reputation, and jeopardize their friendship. The situation is further complicated by the arrival of Almendra, a mutual friend who sets off a chaotic love triangle.

results.title: Conjurig
results.overview: Following a sudden job loss and the dissolution of his romantic relationship in the capital, a dejected young man retreats to his hometown of Bandung, masking his psychological vulnerabilities by donning a traditional ghost costume within a local street-performing subculture.

results.title: Warga Rusun 609
results.overview: The idiosyncratic tenants of a public housing complex must form a unified front to resist an aggressive municipal demolition plan, all while covertly managing a severe supernatural haunting inside Room 609 by an aggrieved spirit demanding an unfulfilled romantic vow.

results.title: Black Market
results.overview: When a rival kidnaps Adesua’s daughter and threatens to burn everything down, the crew faces their most dangerous job yet, one wrong move and they lose more than the money. They lose each other.

results.title: Outskirts
results.original_title: Perigrafia. La città fuori fuoco di Francesco Faraci
results.overview: The documentary explores the outskirts of Palermo through the lens of photographer Francesco Faraci, whose work paints a portrait of the “out-of-focus cities”—areas that have long been marginalized, exploited, and rarely the recipients of adequate investment. This structural neglect has contributed to the entrenchment of conditions of decay, poverty, and a lack of opportunities, fostering the rise of power structures alternative to the state, foremost among them the mafia. Through the story of his own experiences in Sicily’s suburbs, the photographer reflects on possible strategies for regenerating these places, highlighting how they still represent spaces capable of preserving a human and relational authenticity that has progressively disappeared from urban centers.

results.title: A Bit of Light
results.overview: After being arrested and having his medical practice shut down, an Iranian doctor loses faith in the future and resolves to end his life - but one final day among his family begins to unsettle his decision.
